description: For the signed-in person: join a verified charity's team for one of its events on livedot for Good (never one that is over), with where their Support button goes: the charity's donation page, their own fundraising page, or a link they give. Joining puts them on that event's team map only, never anywhere else. Returns the event's link to finish (the one-minute test that makes them Ready). Ask the user before joining.

charity.description: The charity's livedot address (livedot.me/brightpath) or its name.

event.description: The event's name or id, or its link.

name.description: The name the team map shows, if their account has none.

support.description: Where their Support button goes: charity (its donation page), own (their own fundraising page, as their cause), other (support_url).

support_name.description: With support other: what the page is called.

support_url.description: With support other: the https link to their fundraising page.

name: join_charity_team

outputSchema.description: They're on the charity's team for that event (its team map only), with the link to finish.

app.description: The account's app (livedot for Good is on Windline).

charities.description: state pick: the charities to choose from.

error.description: When the call failed: what went wrong, in words for the user.

event.description: The event: { id, name, kind, start, tz, place, url, phase, joined }.

finish_url.description: The event's link to finish joining (the one-minute test that makes them Ready).

message.description: When view is "none": what to tell the user (no match, not live yet, a question back).

signup.description: Without a sign-in: { label, url } to make a free Windline or RunFast account (?ref=mcp).

sponsor_line.description: The line every answer ends with: who brings livedot's live tracking free.

state.description: What happened: preview, made, changed, pick, list, confirm, sent, none, joined, already, link, saved, removed or name.

support.description: Where their Support button goes: { kind, url, name, host }.

view.description: What this answer is; "none" when there is nothing to show (see message).
